scope: AC1018 TABLE title/header/data row text-style hard-pointer output

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: The three table override bits 0x20000, 0x40000 and 0x80000 select title, header and data row text-style H values, each a hard pointer. The handles are in the handle stream; the parser consumes them after cell handles.

implementation.codec: DRW_Table::encodeDwgWithExtension admits the three style bits only when each selected slot has a nonzero, non-NoHandle target; unselected slots must remain zero. The mask now includes exactly these three bits, and the hard pointers are staged after the cell handle sequence in title/header/data order.
implementation.graph_gate: dwgWriter15::hasClosedAc1018TableBlockGraph requires each selected target to resolve through exactly one STYLE-name mapping, be emitted as an object, and, when table records are complete, occur exactly once in the emitted table-record ledger. A supplied row-style name must resolve to that same handle.
implementation.compatibility: No public virtuals or public object layout changes were made. The existing DWG parser and DXF group-7 mapping remain unchanged.

checks: AC1018 body encode and parser readback preserve all three selected hard-pointer handles
following body sentinel remains at the expected body boundary
selected missing and NoHandle targets refuse
whole-table graph gate refuses a selected target that is a TABLESTYLE object rather than a unique emitted STYLE record
generated_control.fixture_policy: The DWG vector is generated in memory from test code. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: Focused object-vector and adapter targets built with repository warning-as-error flags.

limits: Generated codec and in-process graph checks do not establish physical producer ordering or native table rendering/preference semantics.
Parsed TABLE source-range replay remains refused; this slice does not qualify whole-document output or promote support claims.
